concepts.label: Functions Overview (landing page for 18 SQL++ function categories)

notable_absence.finding: This page is a pure table-of-contents/landing page for 18 function-category reference pages (Aggregate, Array, Bitwise, Comparison, Conditional, Date, JSON, Miscellaneous, Number, Object, Pattern-Matching, Search, String, Token, Type, User-Defined, Vector, Window Functions) - it contains no prose beyond one summary sentence and a bulleted link list, and per the batch guidance for pure function/operator reference pages, no concepts or relations were forced. More generally, no privilege/credential-type table appears on this or (by strong implication) the function-category pages it links to, since built-in SQL++ function invocation is not separately access-controlled - access control attaches to keyspace access via the enclosing statement (FROM/SELECT/etc.), not to function calls themselves.
